exams.name: Master Electrician Examination (Certificate A)
exams.notes: Required for Certificate A (master electrician's license); applicant must also have held Certificate B for at least 12 months.
exams.quote: Certificate A shall be issued to any person, firm or corporation engaged in or about to engage in the business of installing wires, conduits, apparatus, devices, fixtures or other appliances and systems; provided, however, that such person or a member of such firm or an officer of such corporation has passed an examination before the state examiners of electricians
exams.citation: Section 3 - Forms Of, and General Provisions Relating To, Examinations, Licenses and Certificates; Records; Manual of Regulations and Licenses

exams.name: Journeyman Electrician Examination (Certificate B)
exams.notes: Required for Certificate B (journeyman electrician's license).
exams.quote: Certificate B shall be issued to any person who has passed an examination before the state examiners of electricians.
exams.citation: Section 3 - Forms Of, and General Provisions Relating To, Examinations, Licenses and Certificates; Records; Manual of Regulations and Licenses

exams.name: Systems Contractor Examination (Certificate C)
exams.notes: Required for Certificate C (systems contractor's license); applicant must also have held Certificate D for at least 12 months.
exams.quote: Certificate C shall be issued to any person, firm or corporation engaged in or about to engage in the business of installing fire warning, security or other systems; provided, however, that such person or a member of such firm or an officer of such corporation has passed an examination before the state examiners of electricians
exams.citation: Section 3 - Forms Of, and General Provisions Relating To, Examinations, Licenses and Certificates; Records; Manual of Regulations and Licenses

exams.name: Systems Technician Examination (Certificate D)
exams.notes: Required for Certificate D (systems technician's license).
exams.quote: Certificate D shall be issued to any person who has passed an examination before the state examiners of electricians.
exams.citation: Section 3 - Forms Of, and General Provisions Relating To, Examinations, Licenses and Certificates; Records; Manual of Regulations and Licenses

interval_years.quote: Each certificate A and certificate C shall expire on July thirty-first every third year
